title: Sharded bundle bootstrap optimizer + onprem Terraform migration
author: Elena Morozova
description: Motivation: air-gapped on-prem installs for large clusters were taking 60-120+ minutes due to monolithic OCI bundles and registry seeding ordering. This PR introduces a shard-aware bundle layout, a preseed planner Terraform module, and a small controller/cli that performs delta-friendly, parallelized registry seeding and atomic workload apply. Goals: reduce initial bootstrap wall time, make upgrades/rollbacks resilient in flaky networks, and expose per-customer shard selection in Terraform for smaller storage footprints.
commits:
1) Add sharded-bundle manifest schema and packer (shard index + component manifests)
2) Implement registry preseed planner Terraform module (modules/registry-preseed) + docs
3) Add rbw-bootstrap CLI (Go) to orchestrate parallel shard sync, verify checksums, and apply Helm charts atomically
4) Helm: make charts idempotent for partial component apply and add readiness probes for staged apply
5) Add e2e harness updates to test slow networks and partial seeds
6) Migrations: update airgap docs and upgrade/rollback playbook
(Each commit atomic and documented in changelog)
release_notes: Sharded airgap bundles (v1): significantly faster initial registry seeding via parallel shard sync; new Terraform module `registry-preseed` for generating shard manifests and bucket planning; rbw-bootstrap CLI to orchestrate verified, delta-friendly applies and staged Helm deploys. See docs/airgap/sharded-bootstrap.md for migration steps.

ci_summary: Initial CI: 1 flaky e2e test failed under 5% packet loss (tests/e2e/sharded-bootstrap/slow-network.test.ts) — addressed by increasing timeouts and adding exponential jitter. Subsequent runs: all checks passed (unit, lint, go vet, helm lint, e2e with network fault injection).
testing_notes: Local validation: packed three sample clusters (small/medium/large) and measured bootstrap time improvements: small (35% faster), medium (48% faster), large (62% faster) on simulated 100Mbps constrained link. Performed upgrade dance: partial shard rollback succeeded without cluster-wide downtime in test harness. Added e2e scenario for interrupted preseed and resume behavior.
migration_instructions: 1) For customers using monolithic bundles: use `rbw-bootstrap pack --convert /path/to/old-bundle` to produce sharded bundles. 2) Run Terraform registry-preseed plan to estimate preseed storage and set `shard_policy` (per-component or balanced). 3) Use `rbw-bootstrap sync --manifest shards/manifest-v1.yaml --parallelism N` to seed registry. 4) Apply helm/airgap with `rbw-bootstrap apply-helm` to ensure staged readiness checks. 5) For upgrades, rely on `--rollback-grace` to keep previous shard images until cutover. Refer to docs/airgap/sharded-bootstrap.md for full playbook.
notes_on_security: Signed manifest support added: pack.go emits SHA256 checksums and an optional GPG-signed manifest. rbw-bootstrap verifies signatures before any write operations. Terraform module includes recommended IAM/bucket ACL minimal privileges in README. Added unit tests for signature verification in internal/oci/indexer.
observability_changes: Added metrics to rbw-bootstrap: registry_sync.duration_seconds, registry_sync.shards_total, registry_sync.failed_shards and exported prometheus-friendly labels (cluster_id, shard_id). Helm templates now emit job completion annotations for Console to pick up and display staged apply duration.
known_limitations: v1 sharding assumes components can be separated into independent OCI image sets; some legacy operators that depend on colocated images may need a conversion wrapper. The packer currently targets GCR/OCI registries; ACR/Artifactory tested but requires minor registry URL mapping (documented).
merge_notes: Squash-merged after approvals from all reviewers and CI green. Post-merge: updated release pipeline to create v1 sharded bundle artifacts and publish example tfvars. SRE scheduled a staged rollout for customers with >10TB onprem registries.
